sources.title: Google Earth AI
sources.snippet: Earth AI unites Google's decades of state-of-the-art geospatial models with actionable reasoning powered by Gemini, empowering everyone to tackle planet-scale challenges.

sources.title: WeatherAI™ | Intelligent Weather Forecasting - WeatherAI™
sources.snippet: Smarter Weather, Powered by AI Neural ensemble forecasting. Real-time data fusion. Accurate to the mile.

sources.title: WeatherEx | Hyperlocal AI Weather Intelligence Platform
sources.snippet: WeatherEx is a global to hyperlocal weather intelligence platform combining advanced weather models, atmospheric physics, proprietary AI/ML and geospatial analytics for energy, agriculture, aviation, navigation and weather sensitive operations

sources.title: Weather API: AI Forecasts, Data & Insights | Google Maps Platform
sources.snippet: Power your business with Google Maps Weather API. Access hyperlocal, real-time forecasts & AI-enhanced insights from Google's advanced weather models.

sources.title: Google DeepMind Open Sources WeatherNext AI Cyclone Forecasting Model
sources.snippet: Google DeepMind's WeatherNext AI model extends tropical cyclone warning lead times by 24 hours and is now freely available as an open-source tool for global researchers.
